profile.headline: Staff Cloud Software Engineer, R&D-Cloud at Cloudera
profile.summary:
As a staff cloud software engineer at Cloudera, I work with cutting-edge technologies to build scalable and reliable cloud platforms and solutions for big data analytics. I have extensive experience in using Amazon EMR, Amazon EKS, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, Kafka, and other tools to design, develop, and deploy cloud-native applications and services.

I have a strong background in big data and cloud computing, with a master's degree from The University of Texas at Arlington and multiple certifications in digital electronics, microprocessors, and microcontrollers. I am skilled in Java and Python programming, as well as Terraform and SaltStack for infrastructure automation. I am passionate about solving complex problems, learning new skills, and collaborating with diverse teams to deliver innovative and impactful outcomes.
